# Beyond the Code

> Beyond the Code is a crypto law podcast hosted by Yitzy Hammer, a crypto and blockchain lawyer at DLT Law in Israel. The show covers the unfiltered legal and regulatory world of cryptocurrency, Web3, and emerging technology — through in-depth conversations with founders, compliance officers, law enforcement officials, policymakers, and the lawyers shaping the future of digital assets.

## About the Show

- Host: Yitzy Hammer — crypto and blockchain lawyer with 7+ years experience, partner at DLT Law, one of Israel's leading digital assets law firms
- 100+ episodes published, running for over 3.5 years
- Guests have included SEC commissioners, Binance's former head of financial intelligence, Charlie Shrem, Ran Neuner, Jake Chervinsky, Hester Peirce, and more

## Topics Covered

Crypto regulation, blockchain law, DeFi, NFTs, stablecoins, SEC/CFTC enforcement, AML/CFT compliance, digital asset policy, Web3 legal frameworks, exchange regulation, token offerings, crypto crime and law enforcement, emerging technology law, Israel crypto law, international regulatory developments.
